 "straight_tracking_xy_rmse_m_s":row["motion"]["straight_11_40s"]["tracking_xy_rmse_m_s"],
 "turn_tracking_xy_rmse_m_s":row["motion"]["turn_steady_42_70s"]["tracking_xy_rmse_m_s"],

 "worst_motion_stage_hip_HF_rad_s":max(cell["stages"][stage]["hip_velocity_band_5_25Hz_rms_rad_s"] for sid,cell in d["cases"].items() if sid.startswith(("right-","left-")) for stage in motionstages)}
 rows.append(row)

 dominated=[]

 a["dominated_by"]=dominated
 if not dominated:pareto.append(a["iteration"])
